faq-retrait.question: Do you offer home delivery?
faq-retrait.reponse: No — all orders are picked up in store only. You are notified as soon as your order is ready for pickup.

faq-paiement.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq-paiement.reponse: MonCash, Visa/Mastercard, PayPal and bank transfer. For a bank transfer, attach proof of the transaction: your order is confirmed once our team has verified it. Promo codes are not available.

faq-b2b.question: How can I get professional (B2B) pricing?
faq-b2b.reponse: Create a Business account and submit your documents (tax ID/NIF, trade register, ID). Once your file is approved by our team, the quantity-based price tiers apply automatically, with no individual negotiation.

faq-garantie.question: How long is my products' warranty?
faq-garantie.reponse: It varies by category: 24 months for solar energy, 12 months for security and air conditioning. Details are shown on each product page.

faq-devis-validite.question: How long is a quote valid?
faq-devis-validite.reponse: A quote answered by our team remains valid for 3 days from the answer.

faq-panneaux-install.question: Can ATC install my solar panels?
faq-panneaux-install.reponse: Our in-house team provides installation assistance for solar equipment purchased through a package or a quote. Contact our support to discuss it.

faq-securite-install.question: Are the security cameras easy to install?
faq-securite-install.reponse: Our PTZ cameras and smart doorbells are designed for easy installation. A guide is provided with each product.

faq-clim-entretien.question: What maintenance does an ATC air conditioner need?
faq-clim-entretien.reponse: Cleaning the filters every 2 to 3 months is recommended to maintain performance and the warranty.
